correctness.rationale: The numerical invariants check exactly. From Lemire's nine ray orbits and printed stabilizers, orbit--stabilizer gives sizes \(20,60,40,10,30,20,40,60,120\), summing to \(400\). I independently reconstructed the eight maximal-cone representatives from Section 7.3 and enumerated all \(240\) signed coordinate permutations in \(\operatorname{Aut}(A_4)\cong S_5\times C_2\); every representative has trivial stabilizer and the eight orbits are disjoint, hence there are \(1920\) maximal cones. Standard smooth complete toric facts then give \(\rho=400-4=396\), Euler characteristic \(1920\), vanishing odd Betti numbers and, by Poincare duality, \((1,396,1126,396,1)\).
residual_risks: The computation concerns Lemire's specific split toric Demazure model, not an arithmetic quotient or its cohomology ring.
